minCGPAPercentage.description: Structured 0-100 equivalent of cgpaRequirement, used by the matching engine. The free-text cgpaRequirement field is kept as-is; this needs manual re-entry by the content team, not a reliable automated parse.

cgpaRequirementUnresolved.description: True when cgpaRequirement's free text couldn't be confidently parsed (e.g. "Contact Us", mixed bachelor/master wording). Distinct from minCGPAPercentage=null, which means a confirmed 'no requirement'. The matching engine must treat this as Needs Verification, never an automatic pass.

tuitionAnnual.description: Annual tuition in EUR. Left null for most Italian public universities, which use ISEE-income-based brackets rather than a flat fee — see tuitionNote.

tuitionNote.description: Qualitative fee-model note shown when tuitionAnnual is null (e.g. ISEE-bracket explanation). Researched and intentionally generic rather than a fabricated precise figure — real per-university brackets are inconsistent even across official sources and change yearly.

applicationFeeEUR.description: Parsed from the free-text admissionFee field where possible (e.g. "€50" -> 50, "No Fee" -> 0).
